item.title: Webb and Gemini Find the Earliest Known Close Pair of Quasars, and It Puzzles Astronomers
item.description: Astronomers using the James Webb Space Telescope and Gemini North report a compact pair of quasars seen just 900 million years after the Big Bang, powered by black holes of 1.5 billion and 400 million solar masses. The study appeared in The Astrophysical Journal Letters.
